name: Bishop Edward Musamusi
title: Bishop
bio: Bishop Edward Musamusi leads Jesus Christ Ministries with a passion for soul-winning, Spirit-filled worship, and raising strong local churches across Kenya. Together with his wife Edith Fedha Musamusi, they shepherd the ministry under the guidance of the Holy Spirit.

name: Rev. Chai Festus
title: Assistant Bishop
bio: Rev. Chai Festus serves as Assistant Bishop and Regional Overseer for Kilifi Region, shepherding branch pastors and advancing Spirit-filled ministry along the coast together with his wife.
